brainRegistration.method: Bone-correspondence similarity registration, followed by recorded regional adjustments. See regionalAdjustments and brainAdjustmentPolicy for the subsequent local deformation fields.
brainRegistration.limitations: Regional teaching context. Brainstem geometry has local crossing-related adjustments, not an independent patient-derived refit. Fine anatomy, illustrative vessel calibres and the open correction-register findings require review.

regionalAdjustments.method: lower-fossa ordered AP resizing, fixed upper midbrain, exact recovered material facets
Recovered posterior-fossa candidate 59, with illustrative cervical continuation; tissue geometry retained through candidates 60 and 61
Ventral pons advances by up to 3 mm with its vessels; preceding reviewed cerebellar arterial fitting retained.
Common brainstem and venous placement fields, then a 0.6 mm maximum local peduncular recess after vein-wall recovery.
Local pontine groove recess, maximum 3.5 mm; arteries fixed.

brainstemAdjustment.method: Common smooth +Y map with rounded pontine prominence, smaller midbrain adjustment, fixed posterior tissue, and constant anterior shift across attached vessel walls. Dural collectors and clival plexus remain stationary.

brainAdjustmentPolicy.scope: Local shape and size registration of brain structures, with vessel fitting assessed separately
preserve: regional anatomical shape and neighbouring interfaces
afterAdjustment: recheck affected vessels and skull clearance
brainAdjustmentPolicy.bounds: Set per region following inspection; no universal displacement tolerance
brainAdjustmentPolicy.bridgingSegments: Tracked native coordinate interfaces audited in final-interface-reconciliation.json; physical lumen continuity not certified
brainAdjustmentPolicy.deepVessels: Some deep vascular transitions adjusted in this working stage. Remaining geometry gates are listed in the final status report; anatomical attachment verification remains incomplete.

candidateStatus: Batch 2 repair checkpoint. Smooth receiving profiles and callosal repair checked. Final anatomical support certification remains incomplete.

deliveryOptimisation.status: Uncompressed authoring export; runtime and mobile optimisation belong to Batch 3

posteriorArterialSmoothing.method: Circular sweeps of smoothed geodesic centrelines, regular shaft radius and labelled boolean branch necks
posteriorArterialSmoothing.reviewStatus: Visual review build; see clearance report

deepVenousExpansion.method: Smooth radius-aware circular sweeps guided by registered neural surfaces, with labelled union ostia
deepVenousExpansion.reviewStatus: Anatomical review required for representative fine channels and illustrative calibres

posteriorFossaExpansion.method: Smooth radius-aware sweeps with labelled local junctions; flattened tentorial channels; selected asymmetric variants; existing lower mesencephalic skin partitioned as pontotrigeminal
landmarkLimitations: Dentate region inferred within cerebellar white matter; no dedicated dentate nucleus mesh
Inferior medullary velum and choroid plexus of fourth ventricle not independently segmented
Middle and inferior cerebellar peduncles constrained by adjacent registered neural surfaces rather than dedicated meshes
Olive, pyramids, obex and cervical root corridors inferred from gross registered surfaces
posteriorFossaExpansion.reviewStatus: Fine regional anatomy and illustrative calibres require specialist review

icaCavernousRefinement.method: Refine anterior chamber profile and round the chamber/ICA-channel junction; preserve posterior reduction and native venous collars

cervicalVesselRefinement.scope: Bilateral upper cervical IJV course and superficial occipital artery crossing

icaSurfaceSmoothing.method: Connected tubular surface remeshing, local branch collars and continuous shared normals; fixed ophthalmic origin centres

regionalMeshRebuilds.method: Native geodesic centreline tubes with smoothed illustrative radius, explicit connected junction, implicit union, 0.12 mm grid, smooth single exterior surface and disjoint selectable patches.
